content: If you're installing the larger purge bin at the same time, now is when you will want to swap to that guide to drill holes, etc: https://help.prusa3d.com/article/install-larger-bucket-on-prusa-core-one-indx_1147539

replies.content:
Providing the link was very helpful, thank you!

To anyone drilling the hole for the larger purge bin, don’t be a dummy like me! Put your side panel down on something soft and frequently clear the chips/metal shavings from around it as you progress through the steps of the bit. I destroyed the finish on my panel, and on my workbench, by neglecting to clear the chips away frequently and also by allowing the panel to slide around a bit as I was drilling. Dumb!!!
